summary: A broad, heavy sell-off: Nifty settled at 22,780 (−1.56%) and Sensex fell 1,124. Midcaps and smallcaps fell harder, and only two Nifty stocks rose.

detail.leaders: Only Dr Reddy's (+1.67%) and Infosys (+0.30%) among Nifty 50 stocks
detail.laggards: PSU Bank (−3.2%), Realty (−2.3%), Oil & Gas (−2.0%), Metal (−1.9%); Adani Ent, Jio Financial, Adani Ports, Tata Motors PV, L&T; MidCap 100 −1.63%, SmallCap 100 −1.83%
detail.tone: The final settle was a shade below the closing-auction print, at Nifty 22,780.25 (−360.25) and Sensex 72,771.72 (−1,124.02). That wipes out Friday's bounce and more, and the index closed at the day's low.
